title: Was any else Lost in mall world ?
content: I had a dream that I was lost in a mall. The mall closed its doors while I was still inside, and I couldn’t get out. No one was there, everyone had already left. I decided to walk from the mall to the subway. I took multiple escalators down to the lower level, but when I got to the subway, there were no trains. I had to wait until the sun came up. It was cold , both in the mall and in the subway ,so I tried to find somewhere warm to stay. While searching, I found someone sleeping in a hidden corner of the subway. They didn’t see me. I kept going back and forth between the mall and the subway. The subway was underneath the mall, about a 30-minute walk north through the underground path. On the way, I ate some chocolate and tried to sleep on the ground. Eventually, I discovered a section beyond the mall with tiny glass apartments. Each apartment had one person living in it. I could see them through the glass, but they couldn’t see or hear me when I called for help. I tried to sleep again until a bus came and took me to a park at night. Sometimes, I dream of different parts of this same dream , like it keeps continuing in pieces.
